mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 50k from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, as indicated by rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) reflects strong consumer demand, which typically precedes higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is below 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates improving inflation dynamics that signal a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.2% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
